title: Legrand Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of HPM Industries Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced its decision not to oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Legrand Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of HPM Industries Pty Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The Australian markets for the manufacture and supply of emergency lighting products and electrical distribution products and accessories were involved in this proposed acquisition.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 13 February 2007 the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - future alignment between Australian and International Standards would facilitate greater import competition for emergency lighting products; - the presence of alternative suppliers of emergency lighting such as Thomas & Betts and Clevertronics; - the constraint that electrical wholesalers, which are an important distribution channel, would provide on the merged firm's pricing of emergency lighting and general electrical products; - the proposed acquisition would not remove a vigorous and effective competitor in the emergency lighting market; - electrical contractors and specifiers can readily switch brands and suppliers in response to any attempted price rice; and - any attempt to offer a bundle of emergency lighting and general electrical products would be in competition to the product range of the market leader in electrical products, Schneider Group.
